name: Menkai Shazetsu
source: The player plays the role of an average high school student in Japan who has a beautiful girlfriend called Sayuri. The two of you walk to school chatting happily while suddenly a vehicle runs towards both of you and crash. You gain consciousness in a hospital. The nurse says you are recovering nicely and should be out of the hospital within a few days. However, you are really concerned about Sayuri because she is nowhere to be seen. You go to the nurse desk and overhear rumors about doctor conductor weird experiments. You need to find out what is happening in this  hospital and rescue Sayuri.
translation: 玩家扮演一名普通的日本高中生，有一個美麗的女朋友，名叫小百合。兩人一路開心地聊著天，走向學校，突然一輛車迎面撞了過來。你在醫院裡醒來。護士說你恢復得很好，幾天之內就可以出院了。然而，你真的很擔心小百合，因為她不見蹤影。你走到護理站，無意中聽到有關醫生進行奇怪實驗的謠言。你需要查明這家醫院發生了什麼並營救小百合。
